en.title: Envoy E175 Nose Wheel Detaches After Landing at Miami Airport
en.summary: An Envoy Embraer ERJ-175 operating American Airlines flight AA-3618 from Cincinnati to Miami lost a nose wheel while vacating the runway after landing on runway 12, and stopped clear of the runway.
body: An Envoy Embraer ERJ-175 on behalf of American Airlines, registration N225NN, performing flight AA-3618 from Cincinnati to Miami, landed on Miami's runway 12, slowed and turned off the runway when a nose wheel detached. The aircraft stopped clear of the runway.
The FAA reported: "LEFT NOSE WHEEL DETACHED WHILE EXITING RUNWAY." As of the report's last update on November 9, the aircraft was still on the ground in Miami about 43 hours after landing.

zh.title: 美鷹航空E175客機降落邁阿密後滑出跑道時前輪脫落
zh.summary: 美鷹航空一架E175客機執行美國航空AA-3618航班由辛辛那提飛往邁阿密，降落12號跑道後滑出跑道時前輪脫落，飛機停在跑道外。
body: 美鷹航空一架為美國航空執飛的Embraer ERJ-175客機，註冊編號N225NN，執行AA-3618航班由辛辛那提飛往邁阿密，降落邁阿密12號跑道後減速滑出跑道時，一個前輪脫落。飛機停在跑道外。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）通報指出，飛機滑出跑道時左側前輪脫落。截至11月9日報導更新時，這架飛機在降落約43小時後仍停留在邁阿密。
